calibration.ridge_rule: add 1e-9 times trace(covariance)/3 to each diagonal entry

score.noise_assumption: centered nonsingular Gaussian calibration residual after declared whitening

decision.candidate_survives: candidate score <= 5 and both preregistered null scores > 5
decision.inconclusive: calibration assumption fails, covariance is singular after fixed ridge, any packet is missing, or a null score <= 5

claim_scope: tests the conjugate first-jet architecture; does not locate a zero or certify apparatus existence
